records.question: What is the total revenue?
records.agent_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(revenue), 2) AS total_revenue FROM sales LIMIT 1000

records.question: How many unique customers are there?
records.agent_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS unique_customers FROM sales WHERE NOT customer_id IS NULL LIMIT 1000

records.question: What are the top 5 countries by revenue, excluding the United Kingdom?
records.agent_sql: SELECT country, ROUND(SUM(revenue), 2) AS total_revenue FROM sales WHERE country <> 'United Kingdom' GROUP BY country ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 5

records.question: Which month had the highest revenue?
records.agent_sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', invoice_date) AS month, ROUND(SUM(revenue), 2) AS total_revenue FROM sales GROUP BY month ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 1

records.question: What are the top 10 products by units sold? Use stock code.
records.agent_sql: SELECT stock_code, MAX(description) AS description, SUM(quantity) AS units_sold FROM sales GROUP BY stock_code ORDER BY units_sold DESC LIMIT 10

records.question: What is the average order value?
records.agent_sql: WITH order_revenue AS (SELECT invoice, SUM(revenue) AS total_revenue FROM sales GROUP BY invoice) SELECT ROUND(AVG(total_revenue), 2) AS avg_order_value FROM order_revenue LIMIT 1000

records.question: What percentage of all invoices were cancelled?
records.agent_sql: WITH invoice_counts AS (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN is_cancelled THEN invoice END) AS cancelled_invoices, COUNT(DISTINCT invoice) AS total_invoices FROM transactions) SELECT ROUND(CAST(cancelled_invoices AS DOUBLE) * 100.0 / total_invoices, 2) AS percentage_cancelled FROM invoice_counts LIMIT 1000

records.question: What percentage of revenue comes from the top 10% of customers?
records.agent_sql: WITH customer_revenue AS (SELECT customer_id, SUM(revenue) AS total_revenue FROM sales WHERE NOT customer_id IS NULL GROUP BY customer_id), ranked_customers AS (SELECT customer_id, total_revenue, NTILE(10) OVER (ORDER BY total_revenue DESC) AS decile FROM customer_revenue), top_10_revenue AS (SELECT SUM(total_revenue) AS rev FROM ranked_customers WHERE decile = 1), total_rev AS (SELECT SUM(revenue) AS rev FROM sales WHERE NOT customer_id IS NULL) SELECT ROUND(CAST(top_10_revenue.rev AS DOUBLE) * 100.0 / total_rev.rev, 2) AS percentage FROM top_10_revenue, total_rev LIMIT 1000

records.question: What percentage of customers placed more than one order?
records.agent_sql: WITH customer_orders AS (SELECT customer_id, COUNT(DISTINCT invoice) AS order_count FROM sales WHERE NOT customer_id IS NULL GROUP BY customer_id) SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN order_count > 1 THEN 1 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS percentage_multi_order_customers FROM customer_orders LIMIT 1000

records.question: By what percentage did revenue change from November 2010 to December 2010?
records.agent_sql: WITH monthly_revenue AS (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', invoice_date) AS month_start, SUM(revenue) AS total_revenue FROM sales WHERE invoice_date >= CAST('2010-11-01' AS TIMESTAMP) AND invoice_date < CAST('2011-01-01' AS TIMESTAMP) GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', invoice_date)), nov AS (SELECT total_revenue FROM monthly_revenue WHERE month_start = CAST('2010-11-01' AS TIMESTAMP)), dec AS (SELECT total_revenue FROM monthly_revenue WHERE month_start = CAST('2010-12-01' AS TIMESTAMP)) SELECT ROUND(((dec.total_revenue - nov.total_revenue) / nov.total_revenue) * 100, 2) AS percentage_change FROM nov, dec LIMIT 1000
